reuse.why: Hooks the new check into the existing withBankAccountGuard wrapper that already fronts all six provider link handlers, alongside the existing assertAccountNotLinked in link.ts.

duplication.why: The closed-account rule is defined once and invoked once, from the shared guard.

placement.why: The assertion lives in accounts/link.ts next to assertAccountNotLinked and is wired in the guard, exactly where the tree puts link preconditions.

scope.why: One helper, one call in the guard and focused unit tests.

maintainability.why: Small, documented, tested helper applied through the single guard, so new providers get it automatically.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All link handlers go through withBankAccountGuard, which now calls assertAccountNotClosed.

one_place.where: assertAccountNotClosed in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/link.ts, called once from withBankAccountGuard in accounts/app.ts, which wraps every *-accounts-link handler.
